title: Haaye Ali Ali Ali
body:
Haaye ali ali ali (2)
<<DIVIDER>>
1. Tegh namazi pe chali
shemma Imamat ki Bujhi
Uthgaya damade nabi
Shoar hai kufe me yahi
Haaye ali ali ali
2  Kahti hai Mehrabe Haram
Sajdaye khaalikh ki khasam
Sar Pe Padhi Teghe Sitam
Khoon me Khaba doob gayi
Haaye ali ali ali
3  Bibiya Karti Hain Fuga
Hgaya Andher Jaha
Haaye Tumhe Paaye Kaha
Aye Gule Gulzaare Nabi
Haaye ali ali ali
4 Daher Se Moo Moad Gaye
Kispe Hame choad Gaye
Sheeshaye Dil Toad Gaye
Kuch to Kaho Haq ke Wali
Haaye ali ali ali
5 Kahti Hai Kusoom Idhar
Khaak Pe Zainab Hai Udhar
Maut hame Na Aagayi
Uth Gaye Duniya Se Pidar
Haaye ali ali ali
6 Thaam Ke Abbas Jigar
Kahte Hain Badeedaye Tar
Haaye Shahe Jinno Bashar
Sarware Aalam ke Wasi
7 The Yahi Sarwar ke sukhan
Aao Chalen Bhai Hasan
Baba Ko Dena Hain Kafan
Hashr Hua Laash Uthi
Haaye ali ali ali
